notes: People you can speak to (src/people.js). The key is their id, used in a level's "people" and in the save's flags.
start: the part of their story they are in before anything has happened. A level puts them where they stand in each part ("when").
look: their stand-in picture (as for creatures). height: metres. stock: the things they trade (src/shop.js), each to be had once.
